summary: Read a rectangular grid of lowercase letters and a list of distinct words to look up. A word can be spelled by starting at one cell and stepping only to a cell that shares a side, following the letters in order. While spelling that one word, a cell may not be entered again. Write every lookup word that can be spelled this way, each word once. Steps may not leave the grid, and diagonal neighbors do not count.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
